contract.scalePlateNote: Code-drawn elevation (abu elevation, canon/blueprints/the-pace-engine.elevation.json) with explicit dimensions: body 0.95 m on a 0.10 m base, 1.0 m wide, dial 0.5 m (half the body width), adult ~1.7 m figure for scale.
contract.map: The identical machine every founder receives on the far side of the portal: a waist-high rounded machine body in flat cream, resting on a low base, with ONE large circular dial on its top and nothing else. The dial carries a single bold needle. At the dial's left end sits a small snail mark; at the dial's right end sits a small winged-block mark (the deck's dial glyphs, a cross-artifact echo of takeoffwithclaude.com's Goldilocks-pace slide). The engine can run at any speed; the dial is the only control it has. The machine itself never differs between founders and never changes between states: only the needle's position, the glow, and what the engine is putting out change.
contract.blocking: Proportions are pinned as numbers and shared by every state. The machine stands waist-high to an adult figure: body 0.95 m tall on a 0.10 m base (about 1.05 m overall against a 1.7 m adult). The body is 1.0 m wide; the dial's diameter is 0.5 m, roughly HALF the body width, standing upright and centered on the top of the body, its face toward the viewer so it reads like a gauge (locked in the blessed master, 2026-08-09). The needle pivots from the dial's center: upright at mid-dial in the steady state, hard right in roar, hard left in cold. The snail mark sits at the left end of the dial's arc, the winged-block mark at the right end; each glyph is small, about one-eighth of the dial's diameter. In frame the engine sits on the ground plane, whole and unobstructed enough that the dial and both glyphs stay legible.
contract.dressing: Ink outlines with flat cream fills (warm cream body, slightly deeper cream base), terracotta-compatible accents; the needle and the two dial glyphs are drawn in ink. State-dependent only: steady adds calm, even warm hum lines rising gently off the body; roar adds a hot glow around the engine and motion blur in its output; cold shows the engine dark and untouched, its cream dimmed toward dusk with NO glow and no hum lines. Never neon, never HUD chrome, never glossy plastic, never 3D render sheen.
contract.scale: Waist-high to an adult: the top of the machine body reaches an adult's waist, and the dial on top sits about hip-to-navel height. In a wide shot it reads as a generous household-appliance-sized machine a founder stands beside, never a room-sized turbine and never a handheld gadget.

master.bake: STEADY (the identity of record): the needle upright at mid-dial, calm even warm hum lines rising gently off the body, the engine at its sustainable hum. Quiet, dependable, warmly lit.

roar.bake: ROAR: the same engine with the needle hard RIGHT, at the winged-block end of the dial, a hot glow around the body and motion blur in the output streaming from it. Overdriven, too fast to be held; the machine itself unchanged.

cold.bake: COLD: the same engine with the needle hard LEFT, at the snail end of the dial, the engine dark and untouched, its cream dimmed toward dusk, NO glow, no hum lines, no output. A dark version of the same machine, never an absence, never broken, never ominous.

prose.lore: The spine object of The Goldilocks Pace, born on the 2026-08-09 Steven Tran prep call: Steven's 'safe velocity' met Gary's 'Goldilocks pace', and the argument became a machine. On the far side of the portal every founder receives this same engine; it can run at any speed, a million miles an hour if asked, and the only control is the one large dial on top. With identical engines and identical plots, outcomes diverge on dial-setting alone: too hot burns the trust down, too cold never builds it, just right compounds. The snail and winged-block glyphs at the dial's ends echo the dial on takeoffwithclaude.com's deck (slide 30, Find your Goldilocks pace), a deliberate cross-artifact echo.
prose.rules: Pass the correct state sheet plus the master as reference on every render (master alone for steady; roar+master for the overdriven engine; cold+master for the dark engine), with the code-drawn blueprint as geometry conditioning. Every state is ONE machine: the body, base, dial, needle and both glyphs never change between states or between founders; only needle position, glow and output change. The cold state is a dark version of the machine, never an absence, never a ruin. The dial carries no lettering, numbers or scale markings, only the snail mark at its left end and the winged-block mark at its right end. Render in the universe's warm-editorial register with the register anchor passed first; never photoreal, never neo-comic, never HUD, never neon, never 3D/CGI/Pixar, never glossy plastic.
